summary: Tested custom layout upload feature in Sauna Calculator. All features working correctly: 1) Upload button appears after selecting size in Layout Catalog, 2) File input accepts image files (jpg, png, webp, gif), 3) Uploaded custom image shows preview with blue styling, 4) Remove button allows deleting uploaded image, 5) Custom image clears catalog selection, 6) Custom image badge appears in header, 7) PDF generation includes custom image on page 1.
